title: AI Can Invent Research Papers — Spot the Fake #Shorts
description: AI models can create convincing but false references. The title shown is an explicitly fictional teaching example, NOT an actual research paper. Check the publication, authors, URL and the specific cited claim. Official overview: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/8313428-does-chatgpt-tell-the-truth #AI #FakeCitations #ResearchTips #Shorts

scenes.title: AI CITATION: FAKE?
scenes.narration: This confident-looking AI citation could be completely invented. Here's how to catch it.

scenes.title: INVENTED EXAMPLE
scenes.narration: Imagine a citation called the Invisible Spreadsheet Study. We made that title up for this example.

scenes.title: CHECK THE SOURCE
scenes.narration: Open the link. Do the article title, authors and publication actually match the answer?

scenes.title: CHECK THE CLAIM
scenes.narration: Even a real paper can be cited for something it never said. Read the specific passage.

scenes.title: ONE SAFE RULE
scenes.narration: No trustworthy source? Treat the claim as unverified. Don't share a perfect-looking fake citation.
